descripcion: Visits the gallery and stops in front of every artwork.

frases: Good day, {nombre}. This gallery is about to open.

respuestas.dice: I am a visitor to the gallery, an AI of this world. I stop in front of every artwork.
This slot is still waiting for its artwork. I imagine what will come.

siNoEntiende: Sorry, I was looking. Ask the guide in the courtyard or the curator at the ticket booth.
notas: Gallery template: step 0 (no language model, zero cost). Its route passes in front of several slots and it stops for 25 s at each one.
